briefs.claim_en: The 'Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026' is providing free laptops to all students from the government.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple sources, including PIB Fact Check (Livemint, 2026-09-21) and Careerindia.com (2026-09-13), state that the 'Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026' is a scam and no such program has been announced by the Government of India. Fact-checking organizations like Vishvas News (2025-02-18, 2023-02-28, 2024-05-08, 2023-08-30, 2024-12-23, 2020-09-29) and Alt News (2019-06-04) have repeatedly debunked similar claims about free laptop schemes from the central government, identifying them as fake or phishing attempts. While some Indian states like Goa (myscheme.gov.in, 2026-09-18), Tamil Nadu, and Uttar Pradesh (Buddy4study.com, 2026-08-25) have their own laptop schemes, a nationwide central government scheme as described does not exist.

briefs.claim_en: The last date to apply for the scheme is October 15.
briefs.brief_en: Careerindia.com (2026-09-13) reports that scam messages about free laptop schemes often include urgent application deadlines to create panic. While the Government of Goa's "Laptop Scheme for Meritorious Students of SC/ST" (myscheme.gov.in) announces its application dates annually, and the Asianet Laptop Scheme in Kerala (asianet.co.in) has a submission deadline of March 31, 2027, there is no evidence to support an October 15 deadline for a central government 'Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026'.
gaps_en: No official statement or announcement confirms an October 15 application deadline for a 'Prime Minister Free Laptop Scheme 2026'.

briefs.claim_en: Users must click on the link www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in to register their name for the scheme.
briefs.brief_en: The Press Information Bureau (PIB) has debunked claims about a "PM Free Laptop Scheme," confirming them as scams designed to collect personal information (Livemint, 2026-09-21). Careerindia.com (2026-09-13) states that scam forwards for free laptop schemes often use non-government URLs and advises checking for .gov.in domains for authentic notices. Buddy4study.com (2026-08-25) adds that official government schemes do not involve direct student applications through such links; instead, colleges identify eligible students and upload their data to official systems. The website www.pm-free-laptop-yojana.in is not an official government domain.
